images.prompt: Photorealistic split-screen vertical fashion editorial image, divided exactly in half by a clean straight vertical seam at the center. The top 28 percent of the whole image is empty plain background on both halves. LEFT HALF: a flat lay product photograph viewed from directly above on a light ivory plaster background, no person, items only in the lower 72 percent, neatly arranged top to bottom with small gaps: a pair of small gold hoop earrings, a deep burgundy fine-knit V-neck sweater with long sleeves laid flat, a small black leather shoulder bag with a thin strap, a pair of black mini shorts in smooth wool fabric, and ONE pair of black leather knee-high long boots with silver buckle straps at the ankle and shaft. RIGHT HALF: a full-body street style photo of a young Korean woman in her 20s wearing exactly the same items: the burgundy V-neck knit sweater loosely tucked into the black mini shorts, the black knee-high buckle boots, the small black shoulder bag on one shoulder, walking on a quiet Seongsu-dong street with exposed concrete walls in soft late afternoon autumn light, only in the lower 72 percent. Headless body-only framing: the photo is cut at the collarbone, NO head, NO chin, NO mouth, NO hair visible at all. Identical items in both halves, realistic fabric textures, 35mm film look. No text, no letters, no logos, no brand marks, no signs.
